messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
人生の道の真ん中で 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた、 正しい道が失われていた。

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Japanese) | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|--------| | Nel | “in the” (locative) | で | “in/at” | OK | | mezzo | “midpoint / middle” | 真ん中 | “middle” | OK | | del | genitive “of the” linking *mezzo* to *cammin* | の | “of” | OK | | cammin | “road / journey” | 道 | “road” | OK | | di | genitive “of” linking *cammin* to *nostra vita* | の | “of” | OK | | nostra | possessive “our” (part of *nostra vita*) | 人生 | “life” (captures “our life”) | OK | | vita | “life” | 人生 | “life” | OK | | mi | reflexive “myself” | 自分 | “myself” | OK | | ritrovai | “found” (past) | 見つけた | “found” | OK | | per | “within / through” (spatial) | の中で | “within” | OK | | una | indefinite article “a” (non‑specific) | — | — | **MISSING** | | selva | “forest / wood” | 森 | “forest” | OK | | oscura | “dark” (adj.) | 暗い | “dark” | OK | | ché | causal “for / because” (resultative clause) | — | — | **MISSING** | | la | definite article “the” (subject marker) | — | — | **MISSING** | | diritta | “right / straight / correct” | 正しい | “right / correct” | OK | | via | “way / path” | 道 | “way” | OK | | era | copular “was / had been” (imperfect) | 失われていた | “had been lost” | OK | | smarrita | “lost / missed” (past participle) | 失われていた | “lost” | OK |
---
### Missing / Problematic Items - **una** – no Japanese equivalent expressed (indefinite article omitted). - **ché** – causal conjunction not rendered in the Japanese resultative structure. - **la** – definite article not rendered (Japanese does not use articles).
All other source tokens are represented in the Japanese translation with appropriate meaning and grammatical function.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: 人生の道の真ん中で - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 2: - Original: 暗い森の中で自分を見つけた、 - Issue: missing “una” - Corrected: ある暗い森の中で自分を見つけた、 - Line 3: - Original: 正しい道が失われていた。 - Issue: missing “ché” and “la” - Corrected: それでその正しい道が失われていた。
``` 人生の道の真ん中で ある暗い森の中で自分を見つけた、 それでその正しい道が失われていた。 ```
